task_goal: Land the spacecraft at coordinates (0,0) safely with minimal fuel consumption and time.
state_space: 8-dimensional vector: normalized x/y position relative to pad, normalized linear velocities, angle, angular velocity, and two boolean leg contact indicators.
action_space: Discrete actions: 0=Do Nothing, 1=Fire Left Orientation Engine, 2=Fire Main Engine, 3=Fire Right Orientation Engine. (Code supports continuous variant).
termination_modes: Lander physics body goes to sleep (not awake).
success_like_ending: Both leg contact booleans are true.
Lander position is within landing pad bounds (x near 0).
Vertical velocity is below safe threshold at touchdown.
failure_like_endings: Lander physics body goes to sleep (not awake).
behavior_trajectory_prior: Initial Stabilization: Counteract initial random force and wind.
Descent & Alignment: Orient lander upright while reducing altitude.
Final Approach: Dampen vertical velocity near pad.
Touchdown: Ensure both legs contact ground within bounds.
reward_design_risks: Hovering indefinitely to minimize fuel penalty without landing.
Crashing into side walls due to aggressive horizontal correction.
Oscillating near the pad without committing to final descent.
